description: This source file implements utility functions and vendor message parsing logic for the prplMesh project, specifically handling vendor-specific TLV parsing and extraction of vendor OUIs.

methods.name: extract_uint8
methods.description: Extracts a uint8 value from a buffer at a given offset.

methods.name: extract_uint16
methods.description: Extracts a uint16 value from a buffer at a given offset, combining two bytes.

methods.name: parse_vendor_message_type
methods.description: Parses vendor-specific TLVs from a CMDU message, processes Airties vendor TLVs, and manages vendor OUI lists.
